title: Volvo EX90: 800-volt technology makes the flagship SUV more cohesive
content: With the switch from a 400-volt to an 800-volt architecture in the EX90, Volvo has achieved more than just a routine model update. As a result, the flagship SUV now charges significantly faster. This has eliminated the biggest weakness of the first version. Our test drive report reveals what else this update brings and where the big Swedish car retains its distinctive characteristics.

title: Horse Powertrain presents methanol range extender
content: Horse Powertrain has unveiled a new range-extender powertrain that runs entirely on methanol. The system combines a 2.0-liter turbo engine with a generator and power electronics, aiming to make EVs more efficient. Additionally, Horse is using an axial flux generator for the first time, which is expected to be more compact and power-dense compared to conventional designs.

title: 全球首發：Xpeng L03 以低價承諾快速充電

title: Volvo begins deliveries of first EX60 models
